crossRefs.note: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me.…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service…
and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or…
For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and…
For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

parallels.note: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

translations.web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
translations.bsb: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
translations.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
translations.asv: Go your ways; behold, I send you forth as lambs in the midst of wolves.
